rationale: The sole evaluated vector was the unchanged initial vector (intercept 3, beta_x 2, beta_z approximately 2, residual_sd 1.004192890506867). All six fixed source constraints were computable for both fit seeds 1301/1302 and both separate replay seeds 2301/2302, with verified generation linkage for all eight source executions. Fit mean squared scaled error was 0.004017047843922261; separate replay error was 0.002003381544214256; the prespecified engineering stopping tolerance was 0.04. Errors vary across seeds and are compatible with finite residual simulation; these four draws do not identify residual shape or prove a stochastic model. No diagnostic specifically warrants structural revision or additional tuning, so retain this source-compatible construction without claiming parameter improvement or target validation.
remaining_limits: The two source means plus differing z composition identify intercept and z contrast only under the shared additive-source assumption; unreported study shifts, interactions or other conditional structures remain alternatives.
Source x is observed only at -1 and +1. Curvature at the target interior x values, conditional z effects and source-to-target transport are unidentified by these summaries.
Triangular residual shape, symmetry, homoskedasticity, independence, tails and subgroup distributions were assumed and are not assessed by mean/SD/adjusted-x-slope agreement.

Each seed is reused across two equal-sized source executions, creating shared residual random-number streams and matching mean/slope errors. Independent source populations therefore do not imply independent Monte Carlo errors; the scalar loss is not a likelihood.

Two fit and two replay seeds describe a few simulation draws, not parameter, evidence or transport uncertainty. Published sampling standard errors are absent, and 0.04 is an engineering MSE tolerance rather than a clinical equivalence margin.

No parameter or structure change occurred: only the initial vector was evaluated before threshold stopping. A smaller replay loss is fresh-draw variation, not demonstrated optimization or independent empirical validation.

No target outcomes or real independent validation were available. Causal effects, individual recovery, quantiles/tails, nonlinear or subgroup analyses and target utility remain unassessed; resolving them requires different conditional/distributional evidence and reserved real independent data.
